name: Inokuchi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Inokuchi village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes with pointed ears.
history: Flag of the former village of Inokuchi in Toyama Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01.

features.role: Inokuchi village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes with pointed ears
